snippet.title: Robot Rescue Revolution - PS3 Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Teyon announces it's upcoming release of a very unique puzzler for PS3, out next month titled, Robot Rescue Revolution. 
Make sure to follow and subscribe for everything PlayStation.
